mutationSummary: Add a reusable source-symbol browser and navigation-first strategy to help agents locate and edit code in unfamiliar repositories.
strategyPatch:
## General source-navigation and minimal-change workflow

When entering an unfamiliar repository:

1. Convert the report into searchable vocabulary: user-visible option names, directive names, error messages, and domain terms. These map directly to source identifiers.
2. Use `source_symbol_browser` to find definitions and references for those identifiers before reading whole files. Search for the most distinctive word first; then broaden if necessary.
3. Read the selected definitions in context. For a bug, trace the data path from input to output: parse/load, transformation, rendering/writing. For a feature, find the analogous existing feature and mirror its hooks.
4. Look at nearby classes and function signatures to understand conventions (naming, options, error handling, extension points). Do not duplicate existing helpers.
5. Make minimal changes: prefer changing the narrowest function/class that owns the behavior. Preserve public API and existing config semantics unless the report says otherwise.
6. Before finalizing, inspect existing tests for the subsystem to match style and add coverage. Run only the relevant test subset; if unavailable, re-read the changed code path and check for edge cases.

tool.name: source_symbol_browser
tool.label: Source Symbol Browser
tool.description: Scans Python files under /testbed without executing them and reports definitions, class inheritance bases, and optional textual references for a symbol. Use it to map where code lives before planning an edit.

symbol.description: Substring to match against function, class, and assignment names.

path.description: Optional path substring used to restrict the search to a subset of Python files.

include_references.description: When true, also report lines containing the symbol text.

max_results.description: Maximum number of definitions and references to include in the response.
